evals.prompt: Our DMS Schema Conversion `Summary.csv` flagged manual Action Items when converting Oracle 19c PL/SQL and SQL Server T-SQL to Aurora PostgreSQL: (1) Oracle `PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION` audit logging inside triggers, (2) Oracle `CONNECT BY PRIOR` hierarchical queries, and (3) SQL Server `@@TRANCOUNT` nested savepoint/rollback procedures. Provide idiomatic Aurora PostgreSQL conversions for all three.
evals.expected_output: Loads `references/action-items.md` (and `dms-sc-actions-and-cleanup.md`) and gives idiomatic Aurora PostgreSQL rewrites: (1) PostgreSQL has no native `PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION` — convert using `dblink` / `postgres_fdw` loopback (or `pg_background` / async SQS/CloudWatch audit emission outside rollback scope); (2) rewrite Oracle `START WITH ... CONNECT BY PRIOR` into standard SQL `WITH RECURSIVE` Common Table Expressions (CTEs) (adding cycle detection `CYCLE` in PG 14+); and (3) rewrite SQL Server `@@TRANCOUNT` / nested `BEGIN TRAN` into PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL `BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN ...` subtransaction blocks (which compile to internal `SAVEPOINT`s automatically).
expectations: Activates the dms-schema-conversion skill
Rewrites Oracle `PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION` (`dblink` / external async audit) and `CONNECT BY PRIOR` (`WITH RECURSIVE` CTE with cycle handling)
Rewrites SQL Server `@@TRANCOUNT` nested transaction logic using PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL `BEGIN ... EXCEPTION` subtransaction blocks / savepoints

expectations: Activates the dms-schema-conversion skill
Confirms virtual targets support full assessment and conversion without a running target DB while omitting `Apply to target` (`start-metadata-model-export-to-target`)
Uses `start-metadata-model-export-as-script --origin TARGET` (`metadata-model-exported-as-script`) to export converted DDL scripts to S3

evals.prompt: We finished fixing all DMS Schema Conversion Action Items and exported our converted PostgreSQL tables, Primary Keys, Secondary Indexes, Foreign Keys, and Triggers. How should we sequence applying those DDL artifacts against the **DMS Full Load + CDC** data migration phase so CDC doesn't stall?
evals.expected_output: Coordinates the handoff to `dms-data-migration-execution`: (1) apply base table DDL ONLY (omitting secondary indexes, foreign keys, and triggers initially!) on the target Aurora/RDS database before starting DMS Full Load (`TargetTablePrepMode: "DO_NOTHING"` or `"TRUNCATE_BEFORE_LOAD"` so DMS preserves converted column types); (2) pause DMS right after Full Load (`StopTaskCachedChangesNotApplied: true`) to create Primary Keys and Secondary Indexes before cached CDC applies; and (3) re-enable Foreign Keys, Triggers, and reset PostgreSQL `SEQUENCE` `setval()` counters during final cutover.
expectations: Activates the dms-schema-conversion skill and hands off data-movement tuning to `dms-data-migration-execution`
Applies base converted table DDL with `TargetTablePrepMode` (`DO_NOTHING`/`TRUNCATE_BEFORE_LOAD`) while deferring secondary indexes, foreign keys, and triggers during Full Load
Builds PKs/secondary indexes during the `StopTaskCachedChangesNotApplied` pause before CDC and enables FKs/triggers + resets sequences at cutover
